title: 'Not about him': Rahul Gandhi expresses regret in defamation case by Shivraj Singh's son
summary: Rahul Gandhi has approached the Madhya Pradesh High Court, expressing regret over a statement allegedly defaming Kartikeya Singh, son of Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. Gandhi's lawyer submitted an application stating the remark was unrelated to Singh.
